findings.claim: "Human owner is the sole decision authority for every role (D-000 clause 1; D-132 Route C grant)."
findings.evidence: D-000 clause 1 (COORD line ~33): "Any decision that would have needed the user is put to an ADVERSARIAL subagent review (prompted to refute, not confirm), iterating to consensus." D-132 user words item 9: "use them to answer questions and not me. between the 3 of you, decide." and item 10: "you are the orchestrator and in charge of getting this work completed". Neither cited entry says the human owner is the sole decision authority for every role; D-132 delegates. The packet's own Option C (delegate under D-000 review) contradicts the sentence.
findings.fix: Remove the sentence or replace it with the cited bytes: D-000 routes user-needed decisions through adversarial review on the user's behalf; D-132 item 9 records the user's delegation; the owner may nonetheless decide directly (user-made entries, D-000/D-132 form).
